{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.82

|eff= local

|gr1= Difficulty

|descr= Command allows suppressing visualization of FRIENDLY, ENEMY, MINES and/or PING map indicators from difficulty setting EXTENDED MAP CONTENT. 

|s1= [[disableMapIndicators]] [disableFriendly, disableEnemy, disableMines, disablePing]

|p1= disableFriendly: [[Boolean]] - [[true]] to disable visualization of friendly units

|p2= disableEnemy: [[Boolean]] - [[true]] to disable visualization of enemy units

|p3= disableMines: [[Boolean]] - [[true]] to disable visualization of mines

|p4= disablePing: [[Boolean]] - [[true]] to disable visualization of all tactical pings

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= Disable visualization of friendly and enemy units:
<sqf>disableMapIndicators [true, true, false, false];</sqf>

|seealso= [[difficultyOption]]
}}
